backend_config.instruction: Solve the problem. Give a short explanation in English, even if the question is not in English. End with exactly one line: FINAL: <number or fraction>, followed by its unit in English only if the answer has a unit; write nothing after a pure number or fraction.
backend_config.decode_policy_note: Greedy non-thinking fixed pilot policy; differs from model-card sampling recommendation.

flag_rule: lowercase; split on [^a-z]+; intersect HINDI_WORDS; sorted unique hits
explanation_rule: Non-FINAL lines: empty => answer only; >=3 ASCII words plus is/are/was/were/has/have/gives/leaves/remains/need/needs/get/gets => explanatory proposition; otherwise labelled equations only. Descriptive, never a gate.
length_rule: Frozen labels.build_example; no truncation; all E/R/C <=1024; last supervised ID 151645; identical E/R/C/EE IDs

chat_template.source: tokenizer_config.json at the pinned revision (no chat_template.jinja exists there)
chat_template.digest_definition: train_smoke.digest(template) = SHA-256 of json.dumps(template) in UTF-8; recorded at run time as chat_template_sha256 by the trainer and by the engine backend

eos_stopping.training_target: reference_solution_en + '<|im_end|>' (id 151645), encoded separately from the prompt; the last supervised token is asserted to be <|im_end|>
eos_stopping.generation_eos_source: model.generation_config.eos_token_id from generation_config.json at the pinned revision (<|im_end|> 151645, <|endoftext|> 151643); pad_token_id = tokenizer pad <|endoftext|> 151643
eos_stopping.stopping: greedy decoding stops at the first generated EOS id or after max_new_tokens = 1024 new tokens
eos_stopping.truncated: no EOS among the generated ids and 1024 tokens generated; scored 0 by scorer v1
eos_stopping.decoding_of_response: tokenizer.decode(ids, skip_special_tokens=True); the raw form with special tokens is also stored
eos_stopping.prompt: chat template with system = frozen instruction, user = rendering, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False (empty <think></think> block); identical at training and evaluation
